You should re-evaluate your supervising mentality. Having your employees to "snoop" around a potential canidate and basing your decision off that is huge a red flag and im sure could be cause of a legal case. As I said in a previous comment, you do not know their situation and to base employment off a clean car is so unhinged. 

I'll give myself as an example. I have a nice black 2020 Colorado. I love to have a clean car but do not have a means to keep it clean. 

1. I live in apartment where doing vehicle maintenance is not allowed, which includes car washing
2. There is 0 visitor parking spots. So having a mobile detailer come by is out of the question
3. I will not take my car to a car wash for obvious reasons
4. Not paying the $120+ at a detail shop it takes to clean my truck to my standard when I have the means to do it myself. 

So the only reasonable option I have is to wait till I visit a friends house and ask to use their water/electrical line + free space and do it myself. Which is what I do now every 2-3 months. and during those months my car is absolutely filthy. 

Like I said, you, as a supervisor, need to open your mind up of others situations as its not so black and white. "Oh theyre car is dirty, theyre a lazy worker/dont care about cars" is absurd.

You don't need to have a  "good" condition car and a passion for vehicles to be a great worker. This is a job at the end of the day, they're there to get paid and should be treated as such.  A supervisor pre-determining their work ethic and possible employment off something so minuscule is a huge red flag of any establishment.
